caption: The drawing depicts a stylized, painted wooden horse positioned in the center of a plain, off-white background. The horse has an overall light beige body with brown shading on the mane and tail. The head features red decorations around the eyes and snout. The horse is adorned with an ornamental red saddle, decorated with white plant-like motifs and bordered in blue, covering its back and sides. The saddle has leg protectors extending down and hugging the horse’s flanks. The hooves are colored dark brown. The horse stands with all four legs visible and slightly apart. There is a handwritten signature and date in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Toy Shetland Pony
